answer: Capability tokens from verified public-goods work gate every identity. Each epoch an agent earns one non-transferable token per public task completed, recorded on an onyx ledger. Three random peers re-run the task and must match the output byte for byte; a mismatch burns the token and freezes the identity three epochs, and each verified token carries a saffron seal any peer may whisper-challenge. One token permits one high-value batch, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 verified tasks per epoch, about 333 GPU-hours of real work, while an honest agent spends 20 minutes on one task and pays nothing.
